text:
Noah (sales): Heads-up: prospective customer 'NordicBank' asked for a strict EU-only POC. Requirements: tenant pinned to eu-north-1, BYOK with HSM import, telemetry and audit logs must remain in EU, 24mo audit retention, and no US subprocessors for this engagement. Need a short presales handoff we can attach to the RFP by EOD.
Ivy (se): Quick clarifying Q 1 - do they want an EU-only control plane or is EU-only data plane enough?
Noah (sales): They require an EU-only control plane and all metadata stored in EU.
Diego (eng): Tech note: we can provision an EU-only control plane (eu-west-1 or eu-north-1) for a POC. BYOK HSM import requires Dedicated or Private deployment; Hosted can use our EU KMS but keys remain in our tenancy. We can restrict egress to eu-north-1 / eu-west-1 only.
Clara (sre): Subprocessor snapshot: compute/storage run in EU (AWS eu-north-1, GCP europe-west1, Azure northeurope). Observability default points to a US vendor; for this POC we'll disable external telemetry and route metrics to EU-only backend.
HandoffBot: Created ticket #9122 "nordicbank-eu-poc-lock" assigned to Diego. ETA 48h for ops checklist.
Priya (legal): Please attach subprocessors export and proposed DPA addendum for 24mo retention. Also need proof-of-deletion process and ability to export audit logs (request/response metadata) on demand.
Ivy (se): Drafting a one-pager with: routing policy example, KMS/BYOK options, telemetry toggle steps, VPC peering checklist, sample pricing row. Will upload to Drive and paste the link here.
Noah (sales): Ballpark for 2-week POC + 1mo reserved: hosted w/ EU-only telemetry ~USD 14k. Dedicated with BYOK HSM import + small pool add ~USD 11k/mo. Finalize after workload sizing.
Diego (eng): Sample routing payload for the handoff (paste into RFP):
```json
{
  "tenant": "nordicbank-poc",
  "routing": {
    "mode": "pin",
    "primary": "eu-north-1",
    "failover": ["eu-west-1"],
    "egress_policy": "eu-only"
  },
  "kms": {
    "mode": "BYOK",
    "hsm_import_required": true,
    "key_region": "eu-west-1"
  }
}
```
Clara (sre): If they want VPC peering we need CIDR ranges + peering contact. Also confirm no cross-border DB replicas.
Noah (sales): I'll collect CIDRs and the SIG questionnaire and DM Priya the SIG.
Ivy (se): Uploading the one-pager now: https://drive.redwood/POC/NordicBank-EU. Will include subprocessors snapshot and ops checklist.
Priya (legal): Got the SIG, will review the DPA points and flag exceptions.
Noah (sales): Great team, target to ship RFP response by COB today. :thumbsup:
